title: The Houses of Europe
narrativeSpine: A clinic threatened by automated reclamation grounds a 2050 technofeudal conflict in infrastructure, enforcement, and the objectives humans assign machines.
firstSceneDraft: The Houses of Europe brings technological sovereignty to a threatened local clinic.
In this science fiction novel, a robot politely requests permission to dismantle it.
An appeal remains pending while the machine’s operational deadline keeps advancing.
The scene makes Europe’s imagined political transformation concrete before naming its institutions.
visualActionProposal: A six-legged reclamation machine waits outside a valley clinic while the mayor holds an appeal; the timer advances before the paperwork is decided.
